t: The Trend PH/JIG/BS 114mm Single Pocket Hole Jig is a compact woodworking tool designed for creating strong, concealed joints. It features hardened drilling sleeves, ensuring accurate and consistent pocket holes for various joinery tasks. This versatile jig works with timber thicknesses from 12mm to 38mm, making it ideal for building cabinets, furniture, and small joinery projects. Its portable design and reversible depth gauges allow for adaptable use in both new construction and repair work, suitable for hard and softwoods and sheet materials. The jig is supplied with a drill, driver bit, and a selection of screws for immediate use.
b: Hardened Sleeves Ensure Accurate & Consistent Pockets
Portable & Adaptable for Multiple Jointing Styles
Reversible Depth Gauges for New & Repair Work
Ideal for Hardwoods, Softwoods & Sheet Materials
Supplied With Drill, Driver Bit & Assorted Screws
Creates Strong, Concealed Joints with Ease
